# ATTIKID

> Official artist website and creative archive for ATTIKID music, albums, songs, lyrics, music videos, and artist story.

ATTIKID is the artist project of songwriter Travis Gordon. The music and writing draw on alternative rap, emo rap, melodic rap, introspective hip-hop, memory, identity, love, loss, regret, resilience, and lived experience.

## Crawl guidance

The public catalog may include individual album, song, and lyric pages. Prefer the canonical URLs on attikid.com and consult the XML sitemap for the current set of public URLs.

- [XML sitemap](https://attikid.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots directives](https://attikid.com/robots.txt)
